details.decomposition: new field at old probe minus old field; new field at last literal-clone probe minus new field at old probe; new field at final probe minus new field at last literal-clone probe. At horizon1 the middle term is literal-clone probe replacement; longer horizons also include earlier motion. Cross covariances are retained.

experiment_contract.algorithm_object: Complete executed checkpoint including population, donor memory, providers and fresh future innovation keys; material metric readout
experiment_contract.exact_identity: Conditional increment b=E[A_next-A], covariance Gamma; two independent groups have discrepancy covariance Gamma/R+Gamma/S. Field/probe decomposition telescopes with all cross covariances.
experiment_contract.execution_contract: Run through the shared Rust LectureSession; preserve full configuration, seed, trajectory evidence, observable normalization and required continuation checkpoints. No standalone supplied dynamics generates lecture observations.
experiment_contract.limitations: The metric is programmed; conditional drift/covariance characterize its actual evolution. Same-state replica calibration does not establish a metric-only closed equation. At horizons>1 the middle probe term includes earlier motion. Built-in revival selects an eligible current-frame donor; historical accepted cloning is retained. The revived source field can itself depend on a historical distance donor. This source convention follows cloning.rs, rather than introducing a different revival law.
experiment_contract.measurement: Native replicas evaluate the programmed conditional metric at final slot position. Exact decomposition uses new field at old probe, literal-clone probe and final probe. Fixed-probe lagged readout remains explicitly selectable.
experiment_contract.title: Conditional material metric drift and covariance

validation.memory_replica_test: history_window2, warmup2, horizon2, four replicas per independent group; both groups have four defined metrics and historical sources are retained before continuation recording

details.probe_convention: fixed slot, final population position plus constant first-coordinate offset; last completed pre-clone conditional context

model: Complete-checkpoint independent replicas; metric evaluated at the final slot position with exact field, clone-probe and motion decomposition
notes: The complete extended checkpoint, including donor memory and provider configuration, is fixed before resampling future seeds. Warmup supplies the baseline recorded companion context.

The material readout retains same-step clone replacement, clone transforms, kinetics and boundary motion through the final slot position. Its field-versus-probe decomposition is an exact component evaluation identity in one chart, without assuming a differentiable clone pullback. The fixed-probe alternative is a lagged selection-context observable.
Metric availability and extinction probabilities are measured explicitly. The displayed observable uses a zero metric on undefined outcomes; no replica is discarded or survivor-renormalized.
